answer: A sybil defense: anchor every identity to the funding path and invite edges it was born from, then correlate those anchors across all agents. One operator running many masks off a single inference pipeline shares roots, so its identities cluster like veins of jade threading one basalt block — distinct on the surface, fused underneath. To fake independence the attacker must anchor each mask to genuinely disjoint capital and a separate invite lineage, paying real money and real social edges per identity instead of forking one wallet, so cost scales with every sybil.
